title: ResourceRef
description: control-plane-parity.md 5.1. `tenant_id` comes from the authorization context; a client-supplied tenant may only be matched against it, never trusted as the value. JSON Schema cannot express where a value came from, so that half is enforced in runtime/control_plane.py::resource_ref.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant, or null for a platform resource that belongs to no tenant (ADR-0070 §三). Still required: parity §5.1 makes tenant_id unconditional, so an absent key would be indistinguishable from a sender that forgot it, while null is an answer.
